decisions.reason: After two years the desk lamp remains somewhat peripheral to the core project portfolio, but its ergonomic fit with office and education applications and low cost of staying in the range still justify waiting.
As a flagship luminaire tied closely to the firm's strategic direction, we would keep it on the market unless results had turned clearly negative.

With another year of learning and the firm's development path favoring LED-based intelligent lighting, the marine HMI searchlight now appears too narrow and weakly aligned to merit further commitment.
